name: RED eTap braze-on front derailleur
weight_description: Published complete-assembly measurement by Ben Delaney, BikeRadar: 162 g for the original eleven-speed RED eTap front derailleur including its battery. The pictured assembly is braze-on without a clamp adapter. The author’s reported complete weight is used directly; no battery or travel-cover mass is added or subtracted by the catalogue.
